Stellantis Names Iveco's Michele Ziosi as Chief Public Affairs Officer
By Najat Kantouar
Stellantis appointed Michele Ziosi as Chief Public Affairs Officer, who joins the company from Iveco Group, to oversee the company's public affairs activities.

The automotive manufacturing corporation said Thursday that Ziosi would report to Emanuele Cappellano, chief operating officer for the Enlarged Europe area for regional responsibilities and to CEO Antonio Filosa on global matters. The appointment takes effect from Oct. 1.

Ziosi, who has more than two decades of international experience in public affairs, had worked at Iveco since 2021 as chief public affairs and sustainability officer and as a member of the executive team.
In his new role, he will oversee Stellantis's engagement with governments, institutions and other key stakeholders with the Enlarged Europe COO, while advising the CEO on strategic matters.
